  getEffectiveAspectRatio,
  resolveCameraViewport,
  projectWorldToScreen,
} from "@babylonjs/lite";

type Vec = { x: number; y: number; z: number };

export interface ShiftTracker {
  mark(): void;
  shift(point: Vec): { dx: number; dy: number };
}

type Mat4 = ReturnType<typeof getViewMatrix>;
type PixelViewport = ReturnType<typeof resolveCameraViewport>;

interface ProjectionState {
  view: Mat4;
  viewProjection: Mat4;
  viewport: PixelViewport;
  backingWidth: number;
  backingHeight: number;
  cssWidth: number;
  cssHeight: number;
}

function positive(value: number, fallback: number): number {
  return Number.isFinite(value) && value > 0 ? value : fallback;
}

function canvasSizes(canvas: HTMLCanvasElement): {
  cssWidth: number;
  cssHeight: number;
  backingWidth: number;
  backingHeight: number;
} {
  let cssWidth = positive(canvas.clientWidth, 0);
  let cssHeight = positive(canvas.clientHeight, 0);

  if (!cssWidth || !cssHeight) {
    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    cssWidth = positive(cssWidth, positive(rect.width, 0));
    cssHeight = positive(cssHeight, positive(rect.height, 0));
  }

  const backingWidth = positive(canvas.width, cssWidth || 1);
  const backingHeight = positive(canvas.height, cssHeight || 1);

  cssWidth = positive(cssWidth, backingWidth);
  cssHeight = positive(cssHeight, backingHeight);

  return { cssWidth, cssHeight, backingWidth, backingHeight };
}

function cloneMat4(matrix: Mat4): Mat4 {
  const m = matrix as unknown as { slice?: (start?: number, end?: number) => Mat4 };
  if (typeof m.slice === "function") {
    return m.slice(0) as Mat4;
  }

  const out = new Float32Array(16);
  const src = matrix as unknown as ArrayLike<number>;
  for (let i = 0; i < 16; i++) {
    out[i] = src[i];
  }
  return out as unknown as Mat4;
}

function captureState(camera: Camera, canvas: HTMLCanvasElement): ProjectionState {
  const { cssWidth, cssHeight, backingWidth, backingHeight } = canvasSizes(canvas);
  const aspect = getEffectiveAspectRatio(camera, backingWidth, backingHeight);
  const view = cloneMat4(getViewMatrix(camera));
  const viewProjection = cloneMat4(getViewProjectionMatrix(camera, aspect));
  const viewport = { ...resolveCameraViewport(camera, backingWidth, backingHeight) };

  return {
    view,
    viewProjection,
    viewport,
    backingWidth,
    backingHeight,
    cssWidth,
    cssHeight,
  };
}

function projectToCss(state: ProjectionState, point: Vec): { x: number; y: number } {
  const result = projectWorldToScreen(point, state.view, state.viewProjection, {
    viewport: state.viewport,
    backingWidth: state.backingWidth,
    backingHeight: state.backingHeight,
    cssWidth: state.cssWidth,
    cssHeight: state.cssHeight,
  });

  return { x: result.cssX, y: result.cssY };
}

function finiteDelta(value: number): number {
  return Number.isFinite(value) ? value : 0;
}

export function trackScreenShift(camera: Camera, canvas: HTMLCanvasElement): ShiftTracker {
  let snapshot: ProjectionState | null = null;

  const tracker: ShiftTracker = {
    mark(): void {
      snapshot = captureState(camera, canvas);

        dy: finiteDelta(now.y - before.y),

    },
  };

  tracker.mark();
  return tracker;
}

import type { Camera } from "@babylonjs/lite";
import {
  getViewMatrix,
  getViewProjectionMatrix,
  getEffectiveAspectRatio,
  resolveCameraViewport,
  projectWorldToScreen,
} from "@babylonjs/lite";

type Vec = { x: number; y: number; z: number };

export interface ShiftTracker {
  mark(): void;
  shift(point: Vec): { dx: number; dy: number };
}

type Mat4 = ReturnType<typeof getViewMatrix>;
type PixelViewport = ReturnType<typeof resolveCameraViewport>;

interface ProjectionState {
  view: Mat4;
  viewProjection: Mat4;
  viewport: PixelViewport;
  backingWidth: number;
  backingHeight: number;
  cssWidth: number;
  cssHeight: number;
}

function positive(value: number, fallback: number): number {
  return Number.isFinite(value) && value > 0 ? value : fallback;
}

function canvasSizes(canvas: HTMLCanvasElement): {
  cssWidth: number;
  cssHeight: number;
  backingWidth: number;
  backingHeight: number;
} {
  let cssWidth = positive(canvas.clientWidth, 0);
  let cssHeight = positive(canvas.clientHeight, 0);

  if (!cssWidth || !cssHeight) {
    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    cssWidth = positive(cssWidth, positive(rect.width, 0));
    cssHeight = positive(cssHeight, positive(rect.height, 0));
  }

  const backingWidth = positive(canvas.width, cssWidth || 1);
  const backingHeight = positive(canvas.height, cssHeight || 1);

  cssWidth = positive(cssWidth, backingWidth);
  cssHeight = positive(cssHeight, backingHeight);

  return { cssWidth, cssHeight, backingWidth, backingHeight };
}

function cloneMat4(matrix: Mat4): Mat4 {
  const m = matrix as unknown as { slice?: (start?: number, end?: number) => Mat4 };
  if (typeof m.slice === "function") {
    const copy = m.slice(0) as Mat4;
    if (copy !== matrix) {
      return copy;
    }
  }

  const src = matrix as unknown as ArrayLike<number>;
  const length = Number.isFinite(src.length) && src.length > 0 ? src.length : 16;
  const out = new Float32Array(length);
  for (let i = 0; i < length; i++) {
    out[i] = src[i] ?? 0;
  }
  return out as unknown as Mat4;
}

function captureState(camera: Camera, canvas: HTMLCanvasElement): ProjectionState {
  const { cssWidth, cssHeight, backingWidth, backingHeight } = canvasSizes(canvas);
  const aspect = getEffectiveAspectRatio(camera, backingWidth, backingHeight);
  const safeAspect = positive(aspect, backingWidth / backingHeight);
  const view = cloneMat4(getViewMatrix(camera));
  const viewProjection = cloneMat4(getViewProjectionMatrix(camera, safeAspect));
  const viewport = { ...resolveCameraViewport(camera, backingWidth, backingHeight) };

  return {
    view,
    viewProjection,
    viewport,
    backingWidth,
    backingHeight,
    cssWidth,
    cssHeight,
  };
}

function projectToCss(state: ProjectionState, point: Vec): { x: number; y: number } {
  const result = projectWorldToScreen(point, state.view, state.viewProjection, {
    viewport: { ...state.viewport },
    backingWidth: state.backingWidth,
    backingHeight: state.backingHeight,
    cssWidth: state.cssWidth,
    cssHeight: state.cssHeight,
  });

  return { x: result.cssX, y: result.cssY };
}

function finiteDelta(value: number): number {
  return Number.isFinite(value) ? value : 0;
}

export function trackScreenShift(camera: Camera, canvas: HTMLCanvasElement): ShiftTracker {
  let snapshot: ProjectionState | null = null;

  const tracker: ShiftTracker = {
    mark(): void {
      snapshot = captureState(camera, canvas);
    },
    shift(point: Vec): { dx: number; dy: number } {
      const frozenPoint: Vec = { x: point.x, y: point.y, z: point.z };
      const current = captureState(camera, canvas);
      const before = snapshot ? projectToCss(snapshot, frozenPoint) : projectToCss(current, frozenPoint);
      const now = projectToCss(current, frozenPoint);

      return {
        dx: finiteDelta(now.x - before.x),
        dy: finiteDelta(now.y - before.y),
      };
    },
  };

  tracker.mark();
  return tracker;
}
